title: COCKPIT (the crew shuttle's nose, ship plan v7)

kit.why: the ship plan v7: the hull narrows to the front (6.53 m at the back, 5.69 m at the front, inside); the nose windows are the sloping roof over the cockpit, its ceiling 2.43 m at the back falling to 1.82 m at the front (the owner's 'ok', 2026-10-14)

notes: From the locked ship plan v7 (data/definitions/ship.json, the owner's 'ok' of 2026-10-14): the cockpit 9 to 12 m from the spike's tip, 3 m deep, 6.53 m wide inside at the back and 5.69 m at the front; the nose windows in the sloping roof over it; 1.82 m clear at the front, 2.43 m at the back.
Contents from the owner's cockpit reference: two pilot seats and consoles, compact (no command floor).
The ship's shape is traced from a shuttle concept by PAUL (zana), found online (the ship plan's notes).
